snippet.title: Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel - Conan DLC & Local Co-Op Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
CONAN THE BARBARIAN ENTERS THE BRUTAL WORLD OF JOTUNNSLAYER: HORDES OF HEL 

The biggest update yet is here - bringing a legendary warrior, a deadly new realm, powerful blessings, and the long-awaited Local Co-op mode.

What’s Included
1. New Playable Hero - Conan the Barbarian
Master the Triumph system and dominate the battlefield with momentum-driven combat.

2. New Map - Stygia
A cursed desert filled with ancient ruins, illusion traps, and undead horrors.

3. New God - Fate
A risk-and-reward system that can transform your run with powerful bonuses.

4. New Boss - Undead Jotunn
Face a necromantic ruler with deadly mechanics and layered attacks.

5. Local Co-op (FREE Update)
Team up in 2-player shared runs with new synergy and fast-paced progression.

He does not ask. He takes.

ENTER THE HEL NOW:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2820820/Jotunnslayer_Hordes_of_Hel/
Conan DLC: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4369830/Jotunnslayer_Hordes_of_Hel__Conan/
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/jotunnslayer-hordes-of-hel-3579b3
PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10015542
Xbox Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/jotunnslayer-hordes-of-hel/9nxtls86cvtq
